name: Drag-and-drop re-parenting and reordering in the outliner
body:
# Drag-and-drop re-parenting

Rows carry `dragPayload={id}`; dropping on a row parents under it (`editorSetParent`), dropping on the panel's root
area unparents, and a drop indicator shows the target while dragging. The backend already keeps world position and
refuses cycles. Uses Chaos's `onDragStart`/`onDrop` props through penumbra-ui-backend.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27 for re-parenting: rows carry dragPayload entity:<id>, dropping on a row parents (keeping world position, refusing cycles) and dropping on the empty tail unparents. Reordering siblings is a follow-up card.
